svg.text: Sheet 2 · Controller I/O: ESP32-S3 pins, interfaces, devices
ESP32-S3 controller · 24 V DC · pin map = firmware/include/config.h
Sheet 2 of 2 · A3 · Eng. Kariem Moussa · GIU

ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 on the main PCB (back wall). Inputs on the left, outputs on the right. Every device is reached by its own FR4 strip with the connector shown (J-number). Interface parts sit on the main PCB.
Each channel: 3.3 V (5 V for SPS30), 0 V, SDAx, SCLx. SPS30 SEL pin → 0 V (I²C mode).
TT-109 off Cu core, TT-103 pre-heat, TT-104 coil · DS18B20 ×3
TT-107 exhaust in, TT-108 exhaust out · DS18B20 ×2
FT-101 fresh-air flow · Omron D6F-W04A1 (24 V supply)
FT-102 supply flow · Omron D6F-W04A1 (24 V supply)
3.3 V → TCA9548A, SHT31 ×3, SDP810 ×2, DS18B20 ×5, pull-ups
0 V → common; ADC reference ground at the board
FAN-101 fresh-air compressor (24 V blower, PWM in)
DV-101 diverter, 24 V spring return (high = air pump)
EEV-101 bipolar stepper: A1 A2 B1 B2
HTR-101 PTC reheat 30 W + 130 °C thermal fuse
USB-C (native USB): flashing + JSON telemetry to the laptop (Live monitor).
Spare: GPIO3/45/46 are strapping pins; GPIO35–37 used by octal PSRAM; leave free.
Compressor speed: 0–3.3 V PWM → RC (fc 16 Hz) → LM358 gain 1 + 5.1k/10k = 1.51 → 0–5 V.
Fans: open-drain inverts PWM (firmware FAN_PWM_INVERTED = true).
